thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: Hosted runtime - multiple KV cache OOMs detected across us-west clusters. Error spike at 17:03 UTC, 5% elevated 5xxs for generation routes. autotriage tag=kv_cache_oom

maria (oncall): I'm on it, grabbing logs and current config. Starting an emergency triage call in #incidents-live.

dennis: Noted. Any obvious source? long-context jobs?

maria (oncall): Early logs show continuous-batching backlog + aggressive prefetch. Sample log: 
```
ERRO kvcache: alloc failed, current_kv_size=145GB, max_allowed=128GB, request_id=aa12...
WARN batching: batch_size spike -> 48 -> 320 in 30s
```

sofia: I see a burst of requests with long prompts (>100k tokens) from a specific API key. Likely runaway context windows + prefetch enabled.

maria (oncall): Plan: 1) throttle prefetch to reduce KV growth 2) temporarily lower continuous-batching max_batch_size for hosted pool 3) evict large prefix caches older than 30m. Applying step 1 now.

ops-bot: Running patch: `curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/configs/prefetch -d '{"max_prefetch_tokens":2048}'` -> 202 Accepted, change_id=chg_8821

maria (oncall): Patch applied. Observability: kvcache usage trending down on us-west-2 hosts. Starting slow drain.

sofia: I'm pushing a canary hotfix to continuous-batching config to cap max_batch_size=64 for hosted-runtime. Command: 
```
kubectl patch cm cb-config -n hosted-runtime --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_batch_size":"64"}}'
```

ops-bot: Deploy queued -> canary -> succeeded on 3 pods.

maria (oncall): Memory usage falling, errors back to baseline within 6m of throttles. However, a few customers still report timeouts. support-bot, please surface impacted customers.

support-bot: Affected: customer X (prod), customer Y (sandbox). Error logs show OOMs for long-single-request jobs. Notified CSMs.

customer-success: We're drafting an incident notification. Will call out: short mitigation (prefetch throttle), ongoing follow-up (config hardening + per-key long-prompt limits).

jake: Heads-up, I'll take the next shift handoff in 30m. What do you want me to watch?

maria (oncall): Watch kvcache total size, evictions/sec, and batching backlog. Run this command to check: 
```
ssh ops@host-uw2-01 'journalctl -u runtime | grep kvcache | tail -n 200'
```
Look for `evict_count` and `prefetch_tokens` spikes. Also keep `max_prefetch_tokens` at 2048 until we finish root cause.

sofia: Root cause notes: customers were using a prompt-caching pattern that inadvertently caused prefix explosion when prefetch tried to fill KV for long contexts. We'll add a hard cap on prefetch per-request and a heuristic to skip prefetch for requests with token_count > 32k. Filing PR now.

maria (oncall): Action items captured: 
- short: keep prefetch throttle and reduced batch_size (oncall)
- medium: PR to skip prefetch on ultra-long prompts (sofia)
- medium: telemetry alert for sudden kv growth per api_key (dennis)
- long: improve eviction policy to weight by prefix length (eng-runtime)

ops-bot: Incident ticket created INC-2026, severity=P2, link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026

maria (oncall): Handing off to @jake in 30m. Current status: mitigated, partial customer impact (timeouts for a small set), controls in place. If growth resumes, escalate and rollback canary to disable prefetch entirely.

jake: Taking over. Thanks @maria. I'll monitor dashboards and confirm customer notifications were sent.

maria (oncall): Final note before handoff: We observed one host that didn't recover due to stale kv shards, restarted the runtime on host-uw2-07 as a last-resort: `systemctl restart rw-runtime`. Post-restart logs show normal behavior.

jake: Acknowledged. I'll validate shard integrity and follow up with a post-incident write-up tomorrow. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026 status update: Mitigated -> monitoring. Pager silenced for this alert group.

maria (oncall): Thanks team. I'll add the timeline and commands to the incident ticket. 

customer-success: We'll send a short customer note once jake confirms nothing else flares up.

jake: Confirmed stable at 18:00 UTC. Leaving throttle in place until PR merges. Closing handoff.
